_readme: Story bible for clay-lighthouse. Characters and locations are locked here. Profile images live in assets/characters/. Scene start frames live in assets/keyframes/. Shot files in shots/ reference these paths. Do not put raw model out/ files or per-case logs here.

style.surface: visible thumbprints and tiny imperfections in the clay, matte clay surface
style.light: warm studio for interiors; cool overcast coastal for exteriors
style.positive: Hand-made plasticine stop-motion look: visible thumbprints and tiny imperfections in the clay, matte clay surface, slightly stepped stop-motion motion, warm studio lighting indoors, solid-colour clay props with simple shapes.
style.negative: photorealistic, smooth glossy CGI, realistic human skin, digital blur, motion smear, extra limbs, two heads, text, watermark

keeper.name: Lighthouse Keeper
keeper.description: Tall lanky clay lighthouse keeper with a drooping ginger moustache, round wire glasses and an oversized yellow raincoat.

terrier.name: Clay Terrier
terrier.description: Short round clay terrier dog standing upright on two legs in a knitted green hat and a tiny red scarf.

kitchen.description: Cosy clay lighthouse kitchen: wooden table, teapot, porthole window, warm lamp light.

doorway.description: Open lighthouse doorway, yellow raincoat flapping, grey-green sea and white waves behind, overcast coastal light.

clifftop.description: Cliff edge above the sea, both characters side by side looking at the horizon, wind, overcast.

source_keyframe_note: Existing practical suite keyframe PI01_clay_pair_keyframe and video-assets/uncle_dog_clay_pair.jpg are the starting identity for the pair. Copy the best approved still into assets/keyframes/S01_kitchen_start.jpg after first generation or from the existing asset.
